page.content:
Dungeon Master of Exandria and creative lead of Critical Role.

How Matthew Mercer connects

  • Topic: Critical Role — Matthew Mercer is the Dungeon Master who made Critical Role's Exandria table.
  • Location: Exandria — Matthew Mercer created the world of Exandria.
  • Work: Campaign 1 — Mercer DMs Campaign 1 for Vox Machina.
  • Work: Campaign 2 — Mercer DMs Campaign 2 for the Mighty Nein.
  • Work: Campaign 3 — Mercer DMs Campaign 3 for Bells Hells.

What is Matthew Mercer?

Matthew Mercer is the Dungeon Master who built Exandria, runs every main campaign at the Critical Role table, and voices a rotating cast of NPCs from Whitestone to the Ruby Vanguard.

Key threads lead to Critical Role, Exandria, Campaign 1, Campaign 2 and Campaign 3.
